_comment: Trae CN (Windows). Save this AS '.trae/mcp.json' at the ROOT of the project Trae is opened in. GOTCHAS: (1) 'mcpServers' is an ARRAY of {name,type,url} here, NOT an object keyed by name like Claude/ZCode. (2) type MUST be camelCase 'streamableHttp' — a hyphenated 'streamable-http' or wrong value makes Trae silently drop the ENTIRE file. If the server's tools don't appear in Trae, first try type 'http' as a fallback.
